peter2.3.p1.b1.text: Beloved, this is now my second letter to you. …

peter2.3.p1.b2.text: Most importantly, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.

peter2.3.p1.b3.text: “Where is the promise of His coming?” they will ask. “Ever since our fathers fell asleep, everything continues as it has from the beginning of creation.”

peter2.3.p2.b1.text: But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water,

peter2.3.p2.b2.text: through which the world of that time perished in the flood.

peter2.3.p2.b3.text: And by that same word, the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

peter2.3.p3.b1.text: Beloved, do not let this one thing escape your notice: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.

peter2.3.p3.b2.text: The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise as some understand slowness, but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.

peter2.3.p4.b1.text: … when the heavens will be destroyed by fire and the elements will melt in the heat.

peter2.3.p4.b2.text: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to conduct yourselves in holiness and godliness

peter2.3.p4.b3.text: But in keeping with God’s promise, we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells.

peter2.3.p4.b4.text: … make every effort to be found at peace—spotless and blameless in His sight.

peter2.3.p5.b1.text: … just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom God gave him.

peter2.3.p5.b2.text: … Some parts of his letters are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, … to their own destruction.

peter2.3.p5.b3.text: Therefore, beloved, since you already know these things, be on your guard so that you will not … fall from your secure standing.

peter2.3.p5.b4.text: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
